title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Understanding the State/Region/Province/County field on the Customer Card
summary: The State/Region/Province/County field on the Customer Card in Business Central dynamically changes its caption and visibility based on the Country/Region master data settings, specifically the 'County Name' and 'Address Format' configuration. Understanding these settings helps explain why the field appears differently across customers and environments.
key_points: The field caption changes dynamically to County, State, Region, or Province depending on country/region configuration
Visibility and caption are controlled by two settings in Countries/Regions master: County Name and Address Format
Address Format determines whether the field displays at all, while County Name sets the localized caption
You can use Custom Address Format to adjust field display order and toggle visibility for specific countries

quotes.text: The field below 'City' dynamically changes its caption, it may display as 'County,' 'State,' 'Region,' or 'Province.'
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core behavior that causes confusion about why the field appears differently in different environments

quotes.text: It is determined by the 'County Name' and 'Address Format' settings in the 'Countries/Regions' master.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the root cause configuration that controls field behavior, allowing users to troubleshoot visibility issues

quotes.text: The 'Address Format' determines whether the field itself should be displayed on the page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the specific setting that controls whether the field appears at all versus just its caption
